// One-off generator of the schema 1 fixtures (BS-98, data contract v2).
//
// Run it ONLY on code of schema 1 (the tag v0.1.0, or any commit before the
// schema 2 change): it builds ten days of synthetic data over all modules
// with the real repositories and commands of the app (`DataHarness` with the
// real projection, a fixed clock, deterministic ids, the fake notification
// platform), then writes
//
//   build/fixtures/v1/v1-database.sql            SQL text dump of the database
//   build/fixtures/v1/v1-database-backup.json    backup of the same database,
//                                                exported by the v1 exporter
//   build/fixtures/v1/rich-backup-v1.json        every field with a non-default
//                                                value (`richBackupJson()`)
//   build/fixtures/v1/fresh-install-backup-v1.json
//                                                backup of a fresh installation
//
// The 90 day sample backup `demo-backup-v1-90-tage.json` comes from the
// existing generator instead:
//   DEMO_TODAY=2026-03-31 flutter test test/tool/demo_backup_test.dart
// and the file `build/demo-backup/demo-daten-90-tage.json`.
//
// The fixtures were made on commit 26243de (`lib/`, `test/` and `pubspec.*` are
// identical to the tag v0.1.0). Usage: copy this file to `test/` of a schema 1
// checkout, remove the `.txt` ending and run
//   flutter test test/gen_v1_fixtures_test.dart
// The output is deterministic: a second run gives identical bytes.
//
// Everything is synthetic ("Mia Muster" does not exist).
import 'dart:convert';
import 'dart:io';

import 'package:drift/drift.dart' show driftRuntimeOptions;
import 'package:flutter_test/flutter_test.dart';
import 'package:self_improvement/core/backup/backup_exporter.dart';
import 'package:self_improvement/core/database/app_database.dart';
import 'package:self_improvement/core/goals/domain/goal_type.dart';
import 'package:self_improvement/core/modules/module_id.dart';
import 'package:self_improvement/core/notifications/application/reminder_providers.dart';
import 'package:self_improvement/core/notifications/domain/reminder_status.dart';
import 'package:self_improvement/core/notifications/platform/fake_reminder_platform.dart';
import 'package:self_improvement/core/onboarding/onboarding_repository.dart';
import 'package:self_improvement/core/providers/command_providers.dart';
import 'package:self_improvement/core/testing/data_harness.dart';
import 'package:self_improvement/features/body/application/weight_providers.dart';
import 'package:self_improvement/features/body/domain/weight_entry.dart';
import 'package:self_improvement/features/body/steps/application/steps_providers.dart';
import 'package:self_improvement/features/focus/application/focus_providers.dart';
import 'package:self_improvement/features/focus/application/workout_providers.dart';
import 'package:self_improvement/features/focus/domain/focus_category.dart';
import 'package:self_improvement/features/focus/domain/muscle_group.dart';
import 'package:self_improvement/features/focus/domain/training_category.dart';
import 'package:self_improvement/features/focus/domain/workout_intensity.dart';
import 'package:self_improvement/features/focus/domain/workout_entry.dart';
import 'package:self_improvement/features/nutrition/application/meal_providers.dart';
import 'package:self_improvement/features/nutrition/application/water_providers.dart';
import 'package:self_improvement/features/nutrition/domain/meal_entry.dart';
import 'package:self_improvement/features/nutrition/domain/water_entry.dart';
import 'package:self_improvement/features/tasks/application/habit_providers.dart';
import 'package:self_improvement/features/tasks/application/task_providers.dart';
import 'package:self_improvement/features/tasks/domain/habit.dart';
import 'package:self_improvement/features/tasks/domain/habit_icon.dart';
import 'package:self_improvement/features/tasks/domain/task.dart';
import 'package:self_improvement/features/tasks/domain/task_priority.dart';
import 'package:self_improvement/shared/local_date.dart';
import 'package:self_improvement/shared/local_time.dart';

import 'core/backup/support/backup_fixtures.dart';

void main() {
  test('build the schema 1 fixtures', () async {
    driftRuntimeOptions.dontWarnAboutMultipleDatabases = true;
    expect(
      AppDatabase.currentSchemaVersion,
      1,
      reason: 'this generator is only valid on schema 1 code',
    );

    // Monday 2026-03-30 06:00 UTC = 08:00 in Berlin (summer time since 03-29).
    final h = await DataHarness.create(
      nowIso: '2026-03-30T06:00:00Z',
      realProjection: true,
    );
    addTearDown(h.dispose);
    final platform = FakeReminderPlatform(
      permission: NotificationPermission.granted,
      clock: h.clock,
    );
    addTearDown(platform.dispose);
    final c = h.createContainer(
      overrides: [reminderPlatformProvider.overrideWithValue(platform)],
    );

    String id() => h.ids.newId();
    DateTime now() => h.clock.nowUtc();
    DateTime at(int day, int hour, [int minute = 0]) =>
        DateTime.utc(2026, 3, 30 + day, hour, minute);
    void setTime(DateTime utc) => h.clock.setNow(utc);

    final onboarding = c.read(onboardingRepositoryProvider);
    final profile = c.read(profileCommandsProvider);
    final settings = c.read(settingsCommandsProvider);
    final modules = c.read(moduleManagerProvider);
    final cards = c.read(dashboardCardRepositoryProvider);
    final goals = c.read(goalsCommandsProvider);
    final weights = c.read(weightRepositoryProvider);
    final steps = c.read(stepsRepositoryProvider);
    final water = c.read(waterRepositoryProvider);
    final meals = c.read(mealRepositoryProvider);
    final workouts = c.read(workoutRepositoryProvider);
    final focus = c.read(focusRepositoryProvider);
    final tasks = c.read(taskRepositoryProvider);
    final habits = c.read(habitRepositoryProvider);
    final reminderPrefs = c.read(reminderPreferencesRepositoryProvider);

    // ------------------------------------------------------------ day 0
    await onboarding.complete(
      commandId: id(),
      draft: const OnboardingDraft(
        displayName: 'Mia Muster',
        heightCm: 168,
        ageYears: 34,
        startWeightGrams: 78000,
        motivationGoals: ['move_more', 'build_habits'],
        goals: {
          GoalType.water: GoalSetting(target: 2500),
          GoalType.steps: GoalSetting(target: 8000),
          GoalType.focusMinutes: GoalSetting(target: 30),
          GoalType.workoutWeekly: GoalSetting(target: 4),
        },
      ),
    );
    await profile.update(
      commandId: id(),
      displayName: 'Mia Muster',
      heightCm: 168,
      ageYears: 34,
      startWeightGrams: 78000,
      targetWeightGrams: 70000,
      motivationGoals: const ['move_more', 'build_habits'],
    );
    await settings.setThemeMode(commandId: id(), themeModeKey: 'oled');
    await settings.setReduceMotion(commandId: id(), value: true);
    await settings.setHaptics(commandId: id(), value: false);
    await cards.setVisible(commandId: id(), cardId: 'nutrition', visible: false);
    await cards.moveBy(commandId: id(), cardId: 'xp', delta: -3);

    // Habits (day 0): a daily one with a reminder, one without, one that is
    // archived later, one that is deleted later.
    final habitRead = (await habits.create(
      commandId: id(),
      draft: HabitDraft.withIcon(
        title: 'Lesen',
        icon: HabitIcon.flame,
        reminderTime: const LocalTime(20, 30),
      ),
    )).entityId!;
    final habitStretch = (await habits.create(
      commandId: id(),
      draft: const HabitDraft(title: 'Dehnen', iconKey: 'heart'),
    )).entityId!;
    final habitOld = (await habits.create(
      commandId: id(),
      draft: const HabitDraft(title: 'Meditation', iconKey: 'moon'),
    )).entityId!;
    final habitGone = (await habits.create(
      commandId: id(),
      draft: const HabitDraft(title: 'Kurzzeitige Gewohnheit', iconKey: 'check'),
    )).entityId!;

    // ------------------------------------------------- ten days of records
    for (var day = 0; day < 10; day++) {
      final date = LocalDate(2026, 3, 30).addDays(day);

      // Morning: weight (not on day 4), water, breakfast, steps of yesterday.
      setTime(at(day, 5, 40));
      if (day != 4) {
        await weights.create(
          commandId: id(),
          draft: WeightDraft(
            weightGrams: 78000 - day * 200 - (day.isEven ? 100 : 0),
            occurredAtUtc: now(),
            beforeToilet: day.isEven,
            afterDrinking: false,
            afterEating: day == 6,
            note: day == 2 ? 'nach dem Aufstehen, „nüchtern“' : null,
          ),
        );
      }
      setTime(at(day, 6, 10));
      await water.quickAdd(commandId: id(), amountMl: 250);
      await meals.create(
        commandId: id(),
        draft: MealDraft(
          name: 'Haferbrei mit Beeren',
          kcal: day == 3 ? null : 380 + day * 5,
          occurredAtUtc: now(),
          note: day == 1 ? 'ohne Zucker' : null,
        ),
      );

      // Midday: water in several sizes, lunch, a workout on most days.
      setTime(at(day, 10, 30));
      await water.create(
        commandId: id(),
        draft: WaterDraft(amountMl: 500, occurredAtUtc: now()),
      );
      await water.quickAdd(commandId: id(), amountMl: 250);
      await meals.create(
        commandId: id(),
        draft: MealDraft(
          name: 'Linsensuppe',
          kcal: 520,
          occurredAtUtc: now(),
        ),
      );
      if (day != 2 && day != 5 && day != 8) {
        setTime(at(day, 16, 30));
        await workouts.create(
          commandId: id(),
          draft: WorkoutDraft(
            category: TrainingCategory.values[day % TrainingCategory.values.length],
            durationMinutes: 30 + day * 5,
            occurredAtUtc: now(),
            title: day.isEven ? 'Oberkörper' : null,
            muscleGroups: day.isEven
                ? const [MuscleGroup.chest, MuscleGroup.shoulders, MuscleGroup.triceps]
                : const [],
            intensity: WorkoutIntensity.values[day % WorkoutIntensity.values.length],
            note: day == 0 ? 'neuer Plan' : null,
          ),
        );
      }

      // Focus: a completed session on most days.
      if (day != 3) {
        setTime(at(day, 7, 0));
        final session = (await focus.start(
          commandId: id(),
          category: FocusCategory.values[day % FocusCategory.values.length],
          plannedSeconds: 1500,
        )).entityId!;
        setTime(at(day, 7, 10));
        await focus.pause(commandId: id(), id: session);
        setTime(at(day, 7, 12));
        await focus.resume(commandId: id(), id: session);
        setTime(at(day, 7, 30));
        await focus.save(commandId: id(), id: session);
      }

      // Habits.
      setTime(at(day, 19, 0));
      await habits.setChecked(
        commandId: id(),
        habitId: habitRead,
        date: date,
        checked: true,
      );
      if (day.isOdd) {
        await habits.setChecked(
          commandId: id(),
          habitId: habitStretch,
          date: date,
          checked: true,
        );
      }
      if (day < 4) {
        await habits.setChecked(
          commandId: id(),
          habitId: habitOld,
          date: date,
          checked: true,
        );
        await habits.setChecked(
          commandId: id(),
          habitId: habitGone,
          date: date,
          checked: true,
        );
      }

      // Evening: dinner, more water, steps of today, tasks.
      setTime(at(day, 18, 0));
      await meals.create(
        commandId: id(),
        draft: MealDraft(name: 'Gemüsepfanne', kcal: 640, occurredAtUtc: now()),
      );
      await water.create(
        commandId: id(),
        draft: WaterDraft(
          amountMl: 750,
          occurredAtUtc: now(),
          note: day == 5 ? 'Glas "kalt" \\ Tee' : null,
        ),
      );
      setTime(at(day, 20, 0));
      await steps.setSteps(
        commandId: id(),
        date: date,
        steps: day.isEven ? 8200 + day * 100 : 5400 + day * 80,
      );
    }

    // ------------------------------------------ tasks (open, done, deleted)
    setTime(at(2, 9, 0));
    final taskTax = (await tasks.create(
      commandId: id(),
      draft: TaskDraft(
        title: 'Steuererklärung vorbereiten',
        description: 'Belege sortieren',
        priority: TaskPriority.high,
        dueDate: LocalDate(2026, 4, 10),
        tags: const ['Finanzen', 'Dringend'],
      ),
    )).entityId!;
    final taskPaper = (await tasks.create(
      commandId: id(),
      draft: const TaskDraft(title: 'Altpapier rausbringen', priority: TaskPriority.low),
    )).entityId!;
    final taskDentist = (await tasks.create(
      commandId: id(),
      draft: const TaskDraft(title: 'Zahnarzttermin buchen'),
    )).entityId!;
    final taskGone = (await tasks.create(
      commandId: id(),
      draft: const TaskDraft(title: 'Gelöschte Aufgabe'),
    )).entityId!;
    setTime(at(3, 17, 45));
    await tasks.setCompleted(commandId: id(), id: taskPaper, completed: true);
    setTime(at(4, 10, 0));
    await tasks.setCompleted(commandId: id(), id: taskDentist, completed: true);
    await tasks.setCompleted(commandId: id(), id: taskDentist, completed: false);
    setTime(at(5, 10, 0));
    await tasks.setCompleted(commandId: id(), id: taskDentist, completed: true);
    await tasks.delete(commandId: id(), id: taskGone);
    expect(taskTax, isNotEmpty);

    // -------------------------------------- corrections, deletions, history
    setTime(at(8, 8, 0));
    // A weight in another zone: the frozen zone and date stay as written.
    h.clock.setTimeZone('Europe/London');
    await weights.create(
      commandId: id(),
      draft: WeightDraft(
        weightGrams: 76600,
        occurredAtUtc: at(8, 7, 30),
        beforeToilet: false,
        afterDrinking: false,
        afterEating: false,
      ),
    );
    h.clock.setTimeZone('Europe/Berlin');
    setTime(at(8, 9, 0));
    // Deleted entries stay as soft deleted rows.
    final extraWater = (await water.create(
      commandId: id(),
      draft: WaterDraft(amountMl: 100, occurredAtUtc: now()),
    )).entityId!;
    await water.delete(commandId: id(), id: extraWater);
    final extraWeight = (await weights.create(
      commandId: id(),
      draft: WeightDraft(
        weightGrams: 99900,
        occurredAtUtc: at(8, 8, 55),
        beforeToilet: false,
        afterDrinking: false,
        afterEating: false,
      ),
    )).entityId!;
    await weights.delete(commandId: id(), id: extraWeight);
    final extraWorkout = (await workouts.create(
      commandId: id(),
      draft: WorkoutDraft(
        category: TrainingCategory.sport,
        durationMinutes: 1,
        occurredAtUtc: now(),
      ),
    )).entityId!;
    await workouts.delete(commandId: id(), id: extraWorkout);
    await steps.deleteDay(commandId: id(), date: LocalDate(2026, 4, 3));
    await habits.setChecked(
      commandId: id(),
      habitId: habitRead,
      date: LocalDate(2026, 4, 5),
      checked: false,
    );
    await habits.delete(commandId: id(), id: habitGone);
    await habits.archive(commandId: id(), id: habitOld);

    // Module switch and goal changes (effective tomorrow).
    await modules.setEnabled(
      commandId: id(),
      module: ModuleId.nutrition,
      enabled: false,
    );
    setTime(at(9, 6, 0));
    await modules.setEnabled(
      commandId: id(),
      module: ModuleId.nutrition,
      enabled: true,
    );
    await goals.update(
      commandId: id(),
      changes: const {
        GoalType.water: GoalSetting(target: 3000),
        GoalType.focusMinutes: GoalSetting(target: 30, enabled: false),
      },
    );

    // ----------------------------- reminders, running session, notifications
    setTime(at(9, 7, 0));
    await reminderPrefs.setNotificationsEnabled(commandId: id(), enabled: true);
    await reminderPrefs.setWaterSlots(commandId: id(), hours: const {10, 14, 18});
    await reminderPrefs.setWaterSlots(commandId: id(), hours: const {10, 18});
    final running = (await focus.start(
      commandId: id(),
      category: FocusCategory.programming,
      plannedSeconds: 3600,
    )).entityId!;
    expect(running, isNotEmpty);
    setTime(at(9, 7, 20));
    final status = await c.read(reminderServiceProvider).reconcile();
    expect(status.lastError, isNull);

    // --------------------------------------------------------------- output
    final counts = <String, int>{};
    for (final table in h.database.allTables) {
      final n = await h.database
          .customSelect('SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM ${table.actualTableName}')
          .getSingle();
      counts[table.actualTableName] = n.read<int>('n');
    }
    // ignore: avoid_print
    print('row counts: $counts');
    for (final entry in counts.entries) {
      expect(entry.value, greaterThan(0), reason: entry.key);
    }

    final out = Directory('build/fixtures/v1')..createSync(recursive: true);
    File('${out.path}/v1-database.sql').writeAsStringSync(
      await _dump(h.database, counts),
    );
    final backup = await BackupExporter(
      database: h.database,
      clock: h.clock,
    ).export();
    expect(backup.isRestorable, isTrue);
    File('${out.path}/v1-database-backup.json').writeAsBytesSync(backup.bytes);
    // ignore: avoid_print
    print('backup records: ${backup.recordCount}, status: $status');

    // Every field with a non-default value, and a fresh installation.
    File('${out.path}/rich-backup-v1.json').writeAsStringSync(
      jsonEncode(await richBackupJson()),
    );
    final fresh = await DataHarness.create();
    addTearDown(fresh.dispose);
    final freshBackup = await BackupExporter(
      database: fresh.database,
      clock: fresh.clock,
    ).export();
    expect(freshBackup.isRestorable, isTrue);
    File(
      '${out.path}/fresh-install-backup-v1.json',
    ).writeAsBytesSync(freshBackup.bytes);
  });
}

/// An SQL text dump: schema and rows in table creation order, one statement
/// per line (rows ordered by rowid, so the output is deterministic).
Future<String> _dump(AppDatabase db, Map<String, int> counts) async {
  final buffer = StringBuffer()
    ..writeln('-- Schema 1 database of synthetic data (BS-98).')
    ..writeln('-- Generated by the real commands of the app at schema 1;')
    ..writeln('-- see test/fixtures/v1/generate_v1_fixtures.dart.txt.')
    ..writeln('PRAGMA foreign_keys=OFF;')
    ..writeln('BEGIN TRANSACTION;');
  final master = await db
      .customSelect(
        'SELECT type, name, tbl_name, sql FROM sqlite_master '
        "WHERE sql IS NOT NULL AND name NOT LIKE 'sqlite_%' ORDER BY rowid",
      )
      .get();
  final tables = [
    for (final row in master)
      if (row.read<String>('type') == 'table') row.read<String>('name'),
  ];
  for (final row in master) {
    if (row.read<String>('type') == 'table') {
      buffer.writeln('${row.read<String>('sql')};');
    }
  }
  for (final table in tables) {
    final rows = await db
        .customSelect('SELECT * FROM "$table" ORDER BY rowid')
        .get();
    for (final row in rows) {
      final columns = row.data.keys.map((k) => '"$k"').join(', ');
      final values = row.data.values.map(_literal).join(', ');
      buffer.writeln('INSERT INTO "$table" ($columns) VALUES ($values);');
    }
  }
  final sequence = await db
      .customSelect("SELECT name, seq FROM sqlite_sequence")
      .get();
  for (final row in sequence) {
    buffer.writeln(
      "DELETE FROM sqlite_sequence WHERE name = '${row.read<String>('name')}';",
    );
    buffer.writeln(
      'INSERT INTO sqlite_sequence (name, seq) VALUES '
      "('${row.read<String>('name')}', ${row.read<int>('seq')});",
    );
  }
  for (final row in master) {
    if (row.read<String>('type') == 'index') {
      buffer.writeln('${row.read<String>('sql')};');
    }
  }
  buffer
    ..writeln('COMMIT;')
    ..writeln('PRAGMA user_version=1;');
  return buffer.toString();
}

String _literal(Object? value) => switch (value) {
  null => 'NULL',
  int v => '$v',
  String v => "'${v.replaceAll("'", "''")}'",
  _ => throw StateError('unexpected value ${value.runtimeType}'),
};
